document.name: Grapple House Kids Jiu Jitsu
document.shortDescription: Play-based no-gi jiu jitsu for Queens kids ages 4-15, held every Monday inside Artists in Motion in Ridgewood.
document.longDescription:
Grapple House describes itself as a kids-first BJJ school in Ridgewood, Queens with play-based no-gi classes for ages 4-15. The official homepage says classes run every Monday at Artists in Motion, invites families to schedule a trial, and notes that no uniform is needed for a first visit.

The same official page lists the location inside Artists in Motion at 62-19 Myrtle Ave, Ridgewood, NY 11385, with contact phone (917) 586-9950 and email grapplehousenyc@gmail.com. Published site metadata and structured business-hours data support a Monday after-school and evening window for the program.

The ClassScout listing image is an ImgBB re-host of Grapple House's official Squarespace logo art.

Sources: https://www.grapplehousenyc.com/ https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6941fad654f2dd175ed0fbf9/20546ef8-6657-4480-aaa8-3db4ade393af/GH+Logo+2027+v2.png?format=1500w
document.announcementDescription: The official homepage says Grapple House runs kids classes every Monday and offers a first class trial.
